name: io.github.wsystemdev/eu-business-data-mcp
title: EU e-invoicing and business checks (EN 16931, Peppol, VAT, sanctions)
description: EN 16931/XRechnung e-invoice validate+create, Peppol routing, EU VAT/EORI, sanctions, KYB. Free tier

tools.name: verify_vat
tools.description:
Validate an EU VAT number against the official European Commission VIES service (27 EU states + XI Northern Ireland).
Use when asked whether a VAT ID is valid/active, before zero-rated reverse-charge B2B invoices, or to get a company's
registered name/address from its VAT number. Input: VAT with country prefix, e.g. 'IE6388047V', 'DE811193231' (spaces/dots ok).
Returns status: valid | invalid | invalid_format | member_state_unavailable (VIES/member state down - retry later, valid=null) | error,
plus name, address (if the member state discloses them; DE/ES often don't) and consultation_number (audit proof) when requester is set.
UK (GB) VAT checks are coming soon: until HMRC live access is granted, GB numbers return
status member_state_unavailable, valid=null, error HMRC_LIVE_ACCESS_PENDING (not charged). For >1 number use verify_batch.

vat.title: Vat
vat.description: VAT number with country prefix, e.g. 'IE6388047V' or 'DE811193231'; spaces and dots are ignored.

requester.title: Requester
requester.description: Optional: your own EU VAT number, so VIES returns a consultation number as audit proof.

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description:
Validate up to 100 EU VAT numbers in one call via VIES (supplier/customer list cleanup, onboarding, invoice runs).
Same per-item result as verify_vat; items with member_state_unavailable should be retried later
(GB items stay member_state_unavailable until HMRC live access is granted; they are not charged).

vats.title: Vats
vats.description: List of up to 100 VAT numbers with country prefix; extra items are ignored.

requester.title: Requester
requester.description: Optional: your own EU VAT number, so VIES returns consultation numbers as audit proof.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description:
Look up a company in official European business registers by name or registry number.
country: FR (SIREN), NO (org.nr), FI (Y-tunnus), CZ (ICO), PL (KRS number or name; names via GLEIF LEI index + KRS record), EE, SK (ICO or name), BE (enterprise number, BE VAT or name), or any other ISO code / 'LEI' (GLEIF).
Name searches return the exact legal entity first (before branches and similar names).
Returns legal name, ID, status/active, address, VAT ID, activity code and official source link.
Each result has origin (national_register|lei_index|register_snapshot), served_from (upstream|cache), cache_age_seconds,
data_source (legacy: live|cache|register_snapshot), data_as_of and match {type id|exact|fuzzy, score}; a name that only
fuzzy-matches below match_threshold (85) gives status not_found with candidates in near_matches.
GLEIF answers (DE, NL, other countries) carry coverage {scope: lei_holders_only}: companies without an LEI are not covered.
If the upstream register itself rate-limits, status is error with error_code upstream_rate_limited and retry_after (seconds).
If the register or GLEIF is down (5xx, timeout, connection error, or a non-JSON page), status is error with
error and error_code upstream_unavailable, a human message naming the register, and retry_after; this is not not_found.
Use to confirm a company exists and is active, find its registry number, or map a name to a VAT ID.
Free: basic company search costs 0 units and does not use the free tool-call allowance; it is only rate-limited.

query.title: Query
query.description: Company name or official registry number (e.g. a French SIREN, Polish KRS, Czech ICO or Belgian enterprise number).

country.title: Country
country.description: Register to search: FR, NO, FI, CZ, PL (KRS or name), EE, SK, BE, another ISO country code, or 'LEI' for GLEIF.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 3).

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description:
Screen a person or company name against official EU, UN, OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists.
Fuzzy matching with transliteration; returns candidate matches with 0-100 scores, list, programme, DOB.
A potential match needs human review; this is a screening aid, not legal advice.

name.title: Name
name.description: Person or company name to screen.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Minimum fuzzy match score from 0 to 100 (default 85); lower finds more possible matches.

birth_year.title: Birth Year
birth_year.description: Optional birth year of a person, to narrow matches.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional ISO two-letter country code, to narrow matches.

tools.name: kyb_check
tools.description:
One-call KYB check of a supplier/customer: EU VAT validation (VIES) + official business register
+ EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions screening, returning a pass / review / fail verdict with reasons.
Use for a fast onboarding go/no-go. For an audit-ready report that also covers EORI, GLEIF LEI, Peppol and a 0-100 risk
score use due_diligence_report; to learn how to invoice a buyer use einvoice_route.
company: a VAT ID ('FR40303265045'), a company name, or a registry id; country: optional ISO code (e.g. 'NO').

company.title: Company
company.description: Company VAT number (best) or company name.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional ISO two-letter country code when a name is given.

requester.title: Requester
requester.description: Optional: your own EU VAT number, so VIES returns a consultation number as audit proof.

tools.name: verify_eori
tools.description:
Validate an EU EORI (customs Economic Operators Registration and Identification) number, e.g. 'SE5560360793',
'DE1234567890123', against the official European Commission EOS service. Use for import/export, customs declarations
and freight-forwarder onboarding. Returns valid/invalid and trader name/address only when the trader consented to publication.
UK (GB) EORIs are not in EOS (HMRC checks those); XI EORIs are.

eori.title: Eori
eori.description: EORI number with country prefix, e.g. 'SE5560360793'.

tools.name: verify_eori_batch
tools.description: Validate up to 100 EU EORI numbers in one call via the official EC EOS service (customs / import-export KYB).

eoris.title: Eoris
eoris.description: List of up to 100 EORI numbers with country prefix.

tools.name: validate_einvoice
tools.description:
Validate an EU e-invoice XML (UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII, e.g. XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML) against the
official CEN EN 16931 rules and, for XRechnung, the KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 rules. Returns valid, and every error with its rule ID
(e.g. BR-CO-10), a plain-English message, XPath and a fix hint. rules: auto | en16931 | xrechnung. Slovak sellers also get eFaktúra field
checks (FR SR transposition v1.13, warnings with ruleset SK-FS); Norwegian sellers get NO-LAW field checks. Peppol-specific rules are not checked yet.
For PDFs use the REST endpoint POST /einvoice/validate. fixes lists concrete fixes for the errors (path, current, suggested,
explanation, apply safe|amounts|manual). autofix=true applies the safe ones to a copy and returns it in autofix.xml with its new
result (the original is unchanged); allow_amount_changes=true also applies total fixes that change the amount due (reported).

xml.title: Xml
xml.description: The e-invoice XML as text: UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII (XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML).

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Rule set: 'auto' (detect from the invoice, default), 'en16931' or 'xrechnung'.

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.description: If true, apply the safe fixes to a copy and return the fixed XML in autofix.xml (the input is never changed).

allow_amount_changes.title: Allow Amount Changes
allow_amount_changes.description: If true together with autofix, also apply fixes that change amounts (e.g. recomputed totals).

tools.name: parse_einvoice
tools.description:
Read an incoming EU e-invoice into one JSON shape: seller, buyer, dates, references, totals, VAT breakdown, payment/IBAN, lines and
attachments. Accepts UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII XML (XRechnung, Peppol BIS 3, Factur-X XML) in xml, or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X
PDF as base64 in pdf_base64. Use when asked to read, extract or book a received e-invoice. Values are returned as written in the invoice;
this does NOT validate it (use validate_einvoice for that).

xml.title: Xml
xml.description: Invoice XML as text (UBL or CII). Give either xml or pdf_base64.

pdf_base64.title: Pdf Base64
pdf_base64.description: Base64 of a Factur-X/ZUGFeRD PDF with embedded XML. Give either xml or pdf_base64.

tools.name: create_einvoice
tools.description:
Create a validated EU e-invoice from simple JSON: UBL 2.1 (format en16931|xrechnung|peppol-bis3), UN/CEFACT CII (cii|xrechnung-cii)
or a ZUGFeRD 2.3 / Factur-X EN 16931 PDF/A-3 hybrid (zugferd|factur-x|zugferd-xrechnung; returns pdf_base64 + the embedded CII xml).
invoice = {format, invoice_number, type_code? (380 invoice, 381 credit note + preceding_invoice),
issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), due_date?, tax_point_date?, delivery_date?, currency (EUR), buyer_reference?, seller: {name, vat_id, street, city,
postal_code, country, email, phone, contact_name, company_id?, company_id_scheme?, legal_form?}, buyer: {...}, lines: [{description, quantity, unit_price, unit?, vat_category (S|Z|E|AE|K|G|O), vat_rate}],
payment: {iban, bic?, terms?}, allowances?/charges? [{amount|percent+base_amount, reason, reason_code, vat_category, vat_rate}]
(also per line)}. Totals and VAT breakdown are computed; returns {valid, xml, totals, errors, fixes}. autofix=true
applies the safe fixes (date formats, codes, VAT ID format, misnamed fields) first and returns the corrected input in autofix.invoice.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.description: Invoice as simple JSON: format, invoice_number, issue_date, currency, seller, buyer, lines, payment (see the tool description).

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.description: If true, first apply safe input fixes (date formats, codes, VAT ID format, misnamed fields); the corrected input is in autofix.invoice.

tools.name: einvoice_route
tools.description:
'Can I e-invoice this company?' id = EU VAT number (e.g. 'BE0403170701') or Peppol id ('0208:0403170701').
Returns VIES VAT status, Peppol registration (Peppol Directory, then SML/SMP; BIS 3 invoice support), the country's B2B e-invoice mandate
(dates, format, source) and the recommended format for create_einvoice. France's PPF directory is not included yet.
Not a risk check: for a counterparty verdict use kyb_check (quick) or due_diligence_report (full report).

id.title: Id
id.description: Buyer's EU VAT number (e.g. 'BE0403170701') or Peppol participant id (e.g. '0208:0403170701').

tools.name: send_einvoice_sandbox
tools.description:
SANDBOX ONLY - never reaches a real buyer. Safe send: first checks the buyer VAT in VIES, whether the buyer can be
reached on Peppol, and the buyer name against EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions lists, then creates + validates the EN 16931 invoice
(same JSON as create_einvoice), and returns one preflight verdict: ok, warn or block, with a plain-English message per check
and, for each invoice error, what is wrong, which field and how to fix it. A block (invalid VAT, close sanctions match,
invoice errors) stops the send. Otherwise it routes, hands off to the transport and returns an Ed25519-signed evidence
receipt (JWS). preflight_only=true: run only the checks and return the verdict, send nothing (use before every send).
checks: subset of ["vat","peppol","sanctions"] (default all; validation always runs). transport: "mock" (simulated,
default), "recommand" or "e-invoice-be" (the UBL is really submitted to that Peppol access point's sandbox, addressed to
W System's own sandbox company). Use it to build and test an integration; real Peppol sending is the REST API POST /einvoice/send with mode=live, after a Peppol mandate and KYC review.
autofix=true (only with preflight_only=true): run the checks on a copy with the safe fixes applied and return it in
autofix.invoice; review it, then send that corrected invoice. A send never changes the invoice.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.description: Invoice as simple JSON (same shape as create_einvoice).

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Sandbox transport: 'mock' (simulated, default), 'recommand' or 'e-invoice-be' (partner sandbox); never reaches a real buyer.

preflight_only.title: Preflight Only
preflight_only.description: If true, only check the buyer (VAT, Peppol, sanctions) and the invoice; nothing is sent.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Optional subset of buyer checks: any of 'vat', 'peppol', 'sanctions' (default all; invoice validation always runs).

autofix.title: Autofix
autofix.description: Only with preflight_only=true: run the checks on a copy with safe fixes applied and return it in autofix.invoice.

tools.name: due_diligence_report
tools.description:
Counterparty due-diligence report in one call: VIES VAT, official business register, EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions,
EC EORI, GLEIF LEI and Peppol e-invoice route, with deterministic risk flags, 0-100 risk score, pass/review/fail
verdict, sources and UTC timestamp. company: VAT ID (best), registry number or name; country: ISO code for names.
Use when you need the evidence for a file or a risk review; for a fast onboarding verdict use kyb_check (fewer sources).

company.title: Company
company.description: Company VAT number (best) or company name.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional ISO two-letter country code when a name is given.

tools.name: check_fr_pa_registry
tools.description:
Is this e-invoicing platform on France's official list of Plateformes Agréées (PA)? name = platform or company name
(e.g. 'Pennylane'), website = its site (e.g. 'https://www.acubeapi.com/'); give at least one. Checks the DGFiP lists on
impots.gouv.fr: registered PAs (with registration date) and operators awaiting interoperability tests. Returns
on_official_list, status (approved | awaiting_interop_tests | possible_match | not_found), scored matches, list date and the
official source. Use for supplier due diligence before the French reform (receive from 1 Sep 2026, SMEs issue from
1 Sep 2027). A 'solution compatible' is not a PA itself. Unofficial copy; the official lists prevail.

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform or company name to look up (give name, website or both).

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-20, default 5).

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description:
Check a RECEIVED invoice before booking or paying it (accounts payable). Give the invoice XML (UBL / CII, XRechnung, Peppol, Factur-X XML)
in xml, or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X / plain PDF as base64 in pdf_base64. Runs EN 16931 / XRechnung validation, the supplier VAT ID in VIES
(and the VIES name against the invoice), the supplier name against EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions, arithmetic (lines, VAT, totals, amount due),
IBAN checksum and country, dates, and (my_vat) whether it is addressed to you. With an API key it also checks the account's invoice history:
duplicates and a changed bank account for a known supplier (payment fraud), and saves the result (GET /inbox/invoices).
Returns verdict ok | review | hold (hold = don't pay yet), ok_to_pay, summary and issues in plain English.

xml.title: Xml
xml.description: Received invoice XML as text (UBL or CII). Give either xml or pdf_base64.

pdf_base64.title: Pdf Base64
pdf_base64.description: Base64 of a received PDF invoice (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X with embedded XML, or a plain PDF).

my_vat.title: My Vat
my_vat.description: Optional: your own VAT ID, to warn when the invoice is addressed to another company.
